selection_policy: Choose the reranker from multilingual language coverage, license, official reproducible runtime and this machine's CPU/RAM before observing ranking results. Do not change qrels.
holdout_configuration: Only primary pool=10; not used for tuning. Freeze the primary configuration before inference.
timing: Warm both model sessions before measuring. No query/score cache; include encoding, Qdrant retrieval, payload and reranking in request timing. Report model loading separately. Stage durations are sequential. Rotate execution order. RAM includes both models in the process; do not attribute total process RAM solely to reranker.
fallback: On reranker failure return the unchanged original Hybrid top-k with an explicit reason; no partial reranking. Retrieval failure remains an error.
limitations: Small source-level binary relevance sets, not answer quality. Compound queries may need more sources than final_k allows. CPU/GPU timings for unselected models will not be invented.
